analysis.reasonEn: RSI at 34.0, entering oversold territory, down from 46.2 five days ago. MACD histogram at -1.1390, continuing weakness, worsened from -0.8503 five days ago. Weekly ADX at 13.2, indicating a non-trending phase; caution against mistaking short-term daily adjustments for trend changes. Current price $81.28 is below SMA200 $83.31 and EMA50 $90.63. 45.7% above 52-week low of $56.60 and 20.2% below 52-week high of $101.62. Approaching Bollinger Band lower band at $79.44. Volume ratio to 5-day average is 2.65, a surge. After five consecutive days of decline, attempts at a rebound are present but lack strong trend reversal signals. Maintaining a wait-and-see approach.
